wikitext: :[Beret Guy and Cueball are talking.] :Beret Guy: Remember how I bought my desk chair from that mysterious shop? :Cueball: I think so? :Beret Guy: Turns out the chair was cursed. :[Beret Guy and Cueball are still talking. Beret Guy has his palms out.] :Beret Guy: So I went back to return it, but the shop was gone!
